meaning:
γυμνάζω
(γυμνός), [in LXX: 2Ma.10:15 * ;]
1. properly, to exercise naked.
2. Generally, to exercise, train the body or mind: 1Ti.4:7, Heb.5:14 12:11, 2Pe.2:14.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin; enticing unsettled souls; having a heart trained in greed; children of cursing;
